title: Cabal SMP
description: Cabal SMP is a fresh Fabric 26.2.x Vanilla server with custom eco + land claim mods and mechanics.
body:
**Welcome to Cabal SMP** — a fresh, chill Java Survival Multiplayer server running on the latest version (26.1.1).

We focus on a clean and enjoyable vanilla+ experience with quality-of-life features:
- **Economy & Auction House** — trade freely with other players
- **Land Claiming** — protect your builds with `/claim`
- **SMP-style gameplay** — survival, building, exploring, and community vibes

No pay-to-win, no heavy mods, no chaos or griefing. Just balanced progression, friendly players, and space to create.

Whether you're a new player looking for help or a veteran who wants a relaxed long-term server, Cabal SMP is built for you.

**Server IP:** `minecraft.thecabal.app`  
**Version:** Java 26.1.1

Join us and become part of the Cabal!
